summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Genenta Science S.p.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its June 2026 annual ordinary shareholders' meeting. The filing covers approval of statutory financial statements and the election of five directors, including the re-appointment of the CEO as Chairman. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a routine corporate governance update and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
